text:
morgan: Quick closure sync from the regional-readiness drill. We need a concise owner/timeline list for remediation items before we mark this one closed.
anya: +1. I can own runbook updates for restore steps. Will push edits and call out ambiguous steps today.
olivia: I scheduled the S3 restore verification for Thu 03/26 09:00 PT. I'll post results to this thread. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/region-restore
luis: Completed DNS TTL rollback to 30s on edge-test zone — change went through at 1901234600. Confirmed propagation in us-west.
devops-bot: backup-verify job #backup-verify-2026-03-25 completed: all regions OK. Artifacts: s3://redwood-backups/2026-03-25/summary.json
sam: Noted recurring pattern: when regional control-plane lagged >45s, the routing policy didn't trigger failover because the health-check TTL was misaligned. Need to tighten health-check window + add a synthetic check.
anya: Runbook TODOs I added: 1) explicit preflight checklist for DB restore 2) steps to rotate KMS keys with fallback, 3) exact command snippets for tsm recovery. I'll tag owners inline.
morgan: Owner roundup: runbook edits -> anya (ETA Tue 03/30), DNS docs -> luis (ETA Mon 03/29), synthetic health check -> sam (ETA Mon 03/29), game-day dry run -> olivia + sam (proposed Fri 04/02). Ping owners if dates don't work.
olivia: Game-day dry run: propose we run with 2 traffic-cut scenarios: a) regional outage simulated via route-blackhole b) partial AZ latency spike. I'll prepare the checklist and coordinate with infra windows.
luis: I'll update the routing config repo with a comment block about automatic fallback precedence. PR draft by EOD.
sam: I'll build the synthetic checker and add alert rules (pager + Slack) — ETA Mon. Also I'll add a small regression test to CI that simulates control-plane lag.
anya: Quick note: added a short snippet to the runbook: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/latest/restore.tar.gz /tmp && tar -xzvf /tmp/restore.tar.gz``` Validate permissions before dry run.
morgan: Thanks. Can everyone drop a one-line status update in this thread when your item is done so I can close the loop?
olivia: Will post restore verification results after Thu test.
luis: DNS docs PR up: https://github.com/redwood/routing/pull/489 — ready for review.
sam: Synthetic checker merged to canary branch, will promote after game-day test.
devops-bot: Reminder: DR game-day calendar invite sent to #infra-schedule for 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC.
morgan: Closing criteria for this thread: all PRs merged, runbook changes live, restore test green, and dry-run checklist executed. If any blocker, flag here by next Tue 03/30.
